MDG.note: Article is about a Starlink licence; nothing on farming.
Nothing on weather service satellite data.

facts.fact: Madagascar's regulator ARTEC signed a five-year licence for Starlink Madagascar on 29 April 2024 to operate broadband, VSAT and GMPC satellite networks, per 2424.mg.

MDG.note: Service expected from Q3 2024, not yet on sale.
